# ImageDecodeException

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Thrown when image bytes cannot be decoded: the compressed pixel data is corrupt or truncated, or the image is larger than `MaxPixels`. Images often come from end users, so catch this where an upload is turned into a document.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `BonniePdfException`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new ImageDecodeException(string message)
new ImageDecodeException(string message, Exception innerException)
```
